errors.quote: The first $b+1\le K$ rounds then act on prefix bits singly, costing $O(TpdK)$.
errors.problem: Wrong schedule. In the paper only the first round (named position $h=\ell-1$, long axes only, when there are any) uses prefix slots. The other prefix rounds, $h=b-1,\dots,0$, come last, after the $qK$ chunk rounds $h=\ell-2,\dots,b$. Decimation in frequency must process slots from high to low, because twiddles read the still-unprocessed lower slots. The count $b+1\le K$ and the cost are unaffected.

$d$ is not free. Lemma synthetic-transform-cost requires $a_dp^\epsilon\le d\le b_dp^\epsilon$, $d\ge2$, $d\ell\le C_\ell p$ and $1\le K=\lfloor d^c\rfloor\le\ell-1$. The page then uses \"$(d-1)q=O(p/K)$\", which holds only because $d\ell\le C_\ell p$.

errors.quote: The contraction $F^+_{\boldsymbol t}B^{-1}L^{-1}$ adds error below $\delta$, so the output is within $3\delta+\eta$.
errors.problem: The exact contraction $\mathcal T_+$ adds no error: it only fails to amplify the incoming $2\delta+\eta$. The error below $\delta$ is the computed opposite procedure's own approximation error on the disk grid input $\widetilde z$. The paper splits these by the triangle inequality.
